name: Minokamo (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Minokamo city emblem in white: a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke with a pointed end.
history: Municipal flag of Minokamo, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 November 1961.

features.role: Minokamo city emblem — a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke with a pointed end
